title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Part 5 is in. `takeFullSnapshot(document, ctx)` returns a `full_snapshot` event. The node is the document from `serializeNode`. `seq` and `timestamp` come from `createEvent` and the clock on the snapshot context, next to the mirror, so sequence numbers stay with that recording. A second snapshot with the same mirror keeps the same ids. The page fixture passes `parseEvent`, has unique ids, and the JSON has no script content, no `on*` attribute, no password, and no relative URL.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.

The PR stays a draft. CDATA sections are still not serialized; the issue steps do not include them.
